messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பயணத்தின் நடுவில்
mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன்,
ché la diritta via era smarrita. ஏனெனில் சரியான பாதை இழந்துவிட்டது.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items.

**Word‑to‑Tamil Alignment Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Tamil → English) | Status | |-------------|----------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------------|--------| | **Nel** | preposition + definite article “in the” | **நடுவில்** (part of) | “in the middle” | OK | | **mezzo** | noun “middle, midpoint” | **நடுவில்** (part of) | “middle” | OK | | **del** | preposition + definite article “of the” | **நடுவில் / பயணத்தின்** (part of) | “of the” (genitive) | OK | | **cammin** | noun “road, journey” | **பயணத்தின்** | “of the journey” | OK | | **di** | preposition “of” | **பயணத்தின்** (part of) | “of” | OK | | **nostra** | possessive adjective “our” | **எங்கள்** | “our” | OK | | **vita** | noun “life” | **வாழ்க்கையின்** | “of life” | OK | | **mi** | reflexive pronoun “myself” | **தன்னை** | “myself” | OK | | **ritrovai** | verb “found” (passato remoto) | **கண்டேன்** | “found” | OK | | **per** | preposition “through, within” | **காடில்** (part of) | “in” | OK | | **una** | indefinite article “a” | **ஒரு** | “a” | OK | | **selva** | noun “forest, wood” | **காடு** | “forest” | OK | | **oscura** | adjective “dark” | **இருண்ட** | “dark” | OK | | **ché** | conjunction “for, because” (causal) | **ஏனெனில்** | “because” | **WRONG** (should be omitted or rendered as a resultative, not a causal “because”) | | **la** | definite article “the” | — (not expressed) | — | **MISSING** | | **diritta** | adjective “right, straight, correct” | **சரியான** | “correct/right” | OK | | **via** | noun “way, path” | **பாதை** | “way” | OK | | **era** | verb “was” (imperfect of *essere*) | — (implied in predicate) | — | **MISSING** | | **smarrita** | past participle “lost, missed” | **இழந்துவிட்டது** | “has been lost / missed” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **WRONG:** `ché` – rendered as “ஏனெனில்” (causal “because”). The source clause is a resultative (“for the right way had been missed”), so the conjunction should be omitted or expressed with a resultative particle, not a causal “because”. - **MISSING:** `la` – the definite article has no direct equivalent in Tamil and was omitted (acceptable, but flagged as missing for completeness). - **MISSING:** `era` – the copular verb “was” is not explicitly present in the Tamil clause; the meaning is carried by the past‑perfect verb “இழந்துவிட்டது”. This omission is noted.
No grammatical agreement errors were detected in the Tamil translation.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பயணத்தின் நடுவில் - Issue: none - Corrected: எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பயணத்தின் நடுவில்
- Line 2: - Original: நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன், - Issue: wrong reflexive pronoun (“தன்னை”); should be “என்னை”. - Corrected: நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் **என்னை** கண்டேன்,
- Line 3: - Original: சரியான பாதை இழந்துவிட்டது. - Issue: missing resultative connector and implicit copula; the clause should stand alone without “ché”. - Corrected: **சரியான பாதை இழந்துவிட்டது.**
```text எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பயணத்தின் நடுவில் நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் என்னை கண்டேன், சரியான பாதை இழந்துவிட்டது. ```
